from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
import json, subprocess
out = Path('/home/zhuhe/litchi-performance-0916/candidate/receipts/release-build.cpu-idle.json')
if out.exists(): raise SystemExit(f'existing {out}')
start = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace('+00:00','Z')
mp = subprocess.run(['mpstat','-P','14,15','1','1'], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
procs = []
for p in Path('/proc').iterdir():
    if not p.name.isdigit(): continue
    try:
        cmd = (p / 'cmdline').read_bytes().replace(b'\0', b' ').decode(errors='replace').strip()
    except (FileNotFoundError, PermissionError):
        continue
    if '/home/zhuhe/litchi-performance-0916/candidate' in cmd or 'cargo build' in cmd:
        procs.append({'pid': int(p.name), 'cmdline': cmd})
end = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace('+00:00','Z')
data = {
    'captured_start_utc': start,
    'captured_end_utc': end,
    'mpstat_command': 'mpstat -P 14,15 1 1',
    'mpstat_exit_code': mp.returncode,
    'mpstat_stdout': mp.stdout,
    'mpstat_stderr': mp.stderr,
    'candidate_processes_after_build': procs,
    'idle_assertion': mp.returncode == 0 and not procs,
}
with out.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(data, indent=2))
